title: Writing: A Discussion Essay on a Social Issue

writingModel.placeholder: Introduction: introduce the issue and state both sides exist
writingModel.hint: Do not give your opinion yet — just present the issue

writingModel.placeholder: Arguments FOR one position (with evidence or example)
Arguments FOR the other position (with evidence or example)
writingModel.hint: Use "On the other hand," "However," "Critics argue that"

writingModel.placeholder: Your conclusion: which side is stronger and why

writingTemplate.hint: Introduce the topic without taking a side

writingTemplate.placeholder: e.g., free university / it increases equality of opportunity
a second supporting argument or example
writingTemplate.hint: Add evidence or a second point for this position

writingTemplate.prefix: On the other hand, critics point out that

writingTemplate.placeholder: a supporting point for the counter-argument
writingTemplate.hint: Give a reason or example for the other side

writingTemplate.prefix: In conclusion, on balance I believe that
writingTemplate.placeholder: e.g., the benefits outweigh the costs / the evidence supports...

items: The question of… is one that divides opinion.
There is ongoing debate about whether…
This is a complex issue with arguments on both sides.
The issue of… has become increasingly important.
Views on this question are strongly divided.
Supporters of this view argue that…
One of the strongest arguments in favour is…
There is compelling evidence that…
For example, in countries such as…
Furthermore, research suggests that…
On the other hand, critics argue that…
However, this view is challenged by…
A significant drawback is that…
Opponents of this position point out…
It is worth noting that…
In conclusion, on balance I believe that…
Taking everything into account…
While both sides have merit, the evidence suggests…
Overall, the case for… is stronger because…
I would argue that… is the more effective approach.

questions.text: "___ housing crisis is one of the most serious issues facing cities today." Choose the article.
questions.hint: "The housing crisis" — specific, known issue being discussed

questions.text: "___ education is the key to social mobility." (General statement)
questions.hint: Education as a general concept: zero article

questions.text: "There is ___ strong argument for government intervention in the housing market."
questions.hint: "A strong argument" — first mention, one argument

questions.text: "___ poor and ___ homeless are the groups most affected by housing shortages."
questions.hint: "The poor / the homeless" = group of people (the + adjective)

questions.text: Which discussion essay phrase introduces the other side correctly?
opts: On the other hand, critics argue that…
In conclusion, both sides are wrong.
questions.correct: On the other hand, critics argue that…
questions.hint: "On the other hand" = transition to opposing view

questions.text: "The society needs more investment in public services" is correct for a general statement.
questions.hint: "Society" as a general concept = zero article, not "the society"

questions.text: "___ government has ___ responsibility to protect ___ most vulnerable."
Which is the correct conclusion phrase?
opts: In conclusion, on balance I believe that free university is stronger solution.
In conclusion, on balance I believe that free university is the stronger solution.
In conclusion, on balance I believe that free university is a stronger solution.
In conclusion, on balance I believe that free university is most stronger solution.
questions.correct: In conclusion, on balance I believe that free university is the stronger solution.
questions.hint: Comparative "stronger" in context of two options = "the stronger"
